title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned the Optician's Reading Card. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Optician's Reading Card
options.lineage: near-vision reading cards and the duochrome test
options.thesis: Squint reads your text the way an optician reads your eyes: one card, two sides, no blame.
options.viewport: Top bar with three real routes; one wide reading card holding the text; a duochrome scale with the score needle above the marked text after a run.
options.risk: Brand pun risk: the optician world has to stay functional, not decorative.

raised.raise: The word lens shows the selected word at specimen scale with its ranked guesses beneath.
Queue and warm-up rows restyle in place and stay lit until the next stage lands.
One grotesque carries display and caption alike; the near-white ground is tinted, never pure.

options.label: Highlighter on a photocopy
options.thesis: The essay as a photocopy, marked up in two highlighter inks.
options.viewport: One sheet of text with marks; verdict above.
options.risk: The most familiar AI-detector look; yellow highlight reads as accusation.

options.label: Variable font specimen
options.case: Fuses poorly: words are not glyphs to be morphed; legibility of the user's text must not vary.
options.kept: Specimen-scale display of a single selected word.

options.label: Design annual plate section
options.case: Fuses poorly: editorial-hairline-mono is a calibration trap and adds furniture to a tool.
options.kept: One grotesque throughout; tinted near-white ground.

options.label: Streaming title wall
options.case: Fuses poorly: Squint has one document, not a catalog.
options.kept: Focus expands one item while the rest dims.

options.label: Boarding pass and gate board
options.case: Holds clarity for queue state; loses audience identification for the verdict and heat view.
options.kept: State restyles a row in place and stays lit until noticed.

options.label: Factory catalog sleeve
options.case: Fuses poorly: coded colour strips hide meaning the user needs in plain words.

options.label: Star atlas
options.case: Fuses poorly: dark-navy chart ground fights long-form reading.
options.kept: Importance carried by mark size on a fixed ramp.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A white SaaS checker with a big percentage gauge, executed well.
canonCard.viewport: Text box left, percentage gauge right.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every detector; the gauge overstates certainty.
